blocks.text: Alcohols aur phenols hydroxy organic compounds hain jin mein kam az kam ek hydroxyl group (-OH) hota hai. Alcohol mein yeh group aliphatic carbon (ring ke baghair wala carbon) se jura hota hai aur phenol mein aryl carbon (aromatic ring ka carbon) se. Yeh compounds har jagah milte hain aur bohat kaam aate hain, is liye in ka parhna ahem hai. Ethanol ko taqreeban har koi janta hai; isay ethyl alcohol ya grain alcohol bhi kehte hain. Sab jante hain ke alcohols fuel (eendhan) ke taur par istemal ho sakte hain.

Kitab ki tasweeron mein: baen taraf, alcohol paudon jaise bio-based maddon (ganna waghera) se banta hai aur biofuel ke taur par istemal hota hai. Daen taraf, phenol disinfectants (jaraseem maarne wali cheezon), jaise sabun aur hospital ke disinfectant liquids, ka hissa hai.

Louis Pasteur ki research se pata chala ke bacteria maujood hain. Is ke baad 1867 mein scientists ne operation ke auzaar aur zakhm phenol ke solution se saaf karna shuru kiye. Phenol ki taqatwar antiseptic (jaraseem maarne wali) khoobi ki wajah se mareez ke operation ke baad bachne ke chances bohat barh gaye. Lekin phenol sehatmand tissues ko bhi jala deta hai, is liye yeh is kaam ke liye bohat sakht tha, aur aakhir kaar is ke mutabadil (alternatives) dhoond liye gaye.

blocks.prompt: Alcohol aur phenol mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Alcohol mein -OH group aliphatic carbon (ring ke baghair wala carbon) se jura hota hai; phenol mein -OH seedha aromatic ring ke carbon (aryl carbon) se jura hota hai.

items: Hydroxy compounds mein kam az kam ek -OH group hota hai: aliphatic carbon par ho to alcohol, aryl carbon par ho to phenol.
Ethanol (ethyl alcohol, grain alcohol) fuel aur biofuel hai; phenol disinfectants mein istemal hota hai.
1867 se phenol antiseptic ke taur par istemal hua, lekin sehatmand tissue jalane ki wajah se is ki jagah narm cheezein aa gayin.
